faqs.q: Sec. 18-424. - I.P.C. Section 712.3.3.3, Discharge pipe and fittings.
faqs.a:
Section 712.3.3.3. Discharge pipe and fittings,
is a new section hereby added to read as follows:
"
712.3.3.3. Discharge pipe and fittings.
When sub-soil drainage systems are installed and are discharged into an approved
                  sump or receiving tank, they shall be discharged in a satisfactory manner within the
                  yard area of the building. The discharge from sump pumps shall not be directly or
                  indirectly discharged into or connected in any manner to the sanitary sewer system."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
